Let us consider the function \(f : x \mapsto \left(x - 4\right)^{2} \times \ln(-4 x)\) defined over ] -∞ ; 0 [.
The aim of the exercise is to evaluate step by step the limit of \(f\), at -∞ and at 0 respectively.
